issues.description: ReferenceError: setIsMounted is not defined — the component calls setIsMounted(true) inside a useEffect but never declares the corresponding useState hook
issues.root_cause: The useState declaration for isMounted/setIsMounted is missing. The developer wrote `setIsMounted(true)` in a useEffect but forgot to add `const [isMounted, setIsMounted] = useState(false);` at the top of the component.

fixes.reason: Adds the missing useState declaration for isMounted so setIsMounted is defined before it is called inside the useEffect.
